Garchik ("Mr. Garchik") disclaims beneficial ownership of any and all of the Issuer's securities reported herein in excess of his actual pecuniary interest. || Held by the Garchik Irrevocable 2019 Trust of which Mr. Garchik is a trustee.

On September 4, 2026, in connection with its dissolution, GULP distributed all of the 130,975 shares of Common Stock held by it in kind to its partners, pro rata in accordance with their respective partnership interests, for no consideration. Mr. Garchik received 8,844 shares of Common Stock in respect of his partnership interest in GULP, which he now holds directly; the remaining 122,131 shares were distributed to the other partners of GULP, in which shares Mr. Garchik had no pecuniary interest. The distribution effected only a change in the form of Mr. Garchik's beneficial ownership of the 8,844 shares and is exempt from Section 16(b) pursuant to Rule 16a-13.
